warning.titlePre: BMW X6 xDrive50i Timing Chain Failure
paragraphs: If your X6 xDrive50i is a pre-2015 model with the N47 diesel engine — that's the early F16 generation — timing chain failure due to chain guide wear is a well-documented pattern, subject to NHTSA recall 18V-755. We replace timing chains, guides, and tensioners as standard on every N47 rebuild.
The later F16 (2015-onwards) and F16 generations use a different engine, the B47, which is significantly more reliable and doesn't share this specific issue.
warning.source: Source: NHTSA Recall 18V-755 — Timing Chain Guide Wear in N47 Engines (2012–2015)
